title: Tagalog singing preflight resource catalog
scope: Original link metadata only. Resource kinds, reported sizes and permissions remain separate. No audio, lyrics, dictionary contents, model weights or third-party code are redistributed.
verification_limits: Primary public metadata and terms were read. This is not a legal clearance, native-language review, listening test, model benchmark or exhaustive inventory. Recheck sources before use.

resources.name: LIEE Filipino Singing Corpus
resources.summary: One performer’s Filipino singing recordings prepared for vocal synthesis.

license.attribution: Credit LIEE; voicer and labeller: Julilyn Ng (julieraptor).
license.training_use: Permits credited parallel learning for multispeaker DiffSinger and other vocal synthesis systems. Voice changers are prohibited.
license.redistribution: Raw corpus redistribution prohibited; distributing a recreated LIEE bank requires written permission.
license.commercial_use: Creator permits commercial distribution of synthesis banks using the corpus as parallel material.
uncertainties: These terms do not establish permission for every training method or clear third-party composition rights.

fit.pronunciation_frontend: Useful labeled Filipino phone examples; mapping must match the target model.
fit.svs_training: Candidate for the specifically permitted synthesis uses; small single-performer corpus.
fit.svc_guide: Not permitted for Diff-SVC, RVC or other voice changers.

resources.evidence_status: creator_report_and_release_metadata; no audio downloaded or listened to

resources.name: tiny-tagalog-dataset

annotations: USAP phones with cl replacing q

fit.pronunciation_frontend: Useful phone and label conventions; processed recordings are not a pristine recording baseline.
fit.svs_training: Small noncommercial training or alignment candidate, subject to rights checks.
fit.svc_guide: No general consent for third-party voice imitation is established.
